plainTranslation: You love the same way and value the same things. Shared tastes, aligned affection, an easy sense that you like the same stuff. Failure mode: so similar you never grow past shared blind spots - including how you both dodge hard conversations. Enjoy the harmony; bring in some difference so it doesn't go stale.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
You probably noticed it early, in something small. They reached for the same thing you would have. They lit up at the place you secretly love. You did not have to explain why something was worth it, because they already felt the pull. There is a specific pleasure in being wanted-alike, in not having to translate your taste to someone who already shares it.

When this works, ordinary life gets easy in a way you might not even notice until you compare it to other relationships. So many small choices never have to become discussions. Where to eat, how to spend the afternoon, what is worth the money. You agree before anyone has to argue, and that agreement is its own kind of intimacy. You feel recognized, not just liked.

Here is the part that is harder to see from inside it. Wanting the same things is not the same as wanting good things. The very fact that you never have to justify yourselves to each other means nobody is ever the brake. You may indulge the same habit, overspend in the same place, talk each other into the same thing, and call it shared taste when it is closer to a shared blind spot. The person who would normally talk you down is busy agreeing with you.

Enjoy how good it feels to want the same things. Just stay awake inside it. The gift is not that you agree. The gift is the chance to choose well together, which sometimes means being the one who asks whether you actually should.
